answer: To register, an identity burns one unique relic — its serial enters the vault's burn registry — and locks a 70-credit bond; the vault refuses a burned relic. At each summit audit, auditors re-check it; a duplicate serial burns the bond. One fake pays 60 plus the 70 lock, so 1,000 fakes cost 130,000 against at most 40,000 reward. A recycled-relic ring fails: one serial burns once. An honest agent burns one relic once.
